classFeatures.description: You gain the Rage action, which lets you fly into a frenzy.
classFeatures.name: Rage
classFeatures.rules_text:
You tap into your inner fury and begin raging. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Constitution modifier. While you are raging:
- You deal 2 additional damage on melee Strikes. This additional damage is halved if your weapon or unarmed attack is agile.
- You can't use actions with the concentrate trait unless they also have the rage trait. You can Seek while raging.

Rage lasts for 1 minute, until you fall unconscious, or until the encounter ends, whichever comes first. You can't voluntarily stop raging. When you stop raging, you lose any remaining temporary Hit Points from Rage, and can't gain temporary Hit Points from using the Rage action again for 1 minute.

classFeatures.description: You gain the Quick-Tempered free action, which lets you Rage at the slightest provocation.
classFeatures.name: Quick-Tempered
classFeatures.requirements: You are not encumbered or wearing heavy armor.
classFeatures.rules_text: So long as you are able to move freely, your fury is instinctive and instantaneous. You Rage.

classFeatures.description: Your rage wells up from a dominant instinct—one you learned from a tradition or that comes naturally to you. Your instinct gives you an ability, requires you to avoid certain behaviors, grants you increased damage and resistances at higher levels, and allows you to select feats tied to your instinct.
classFeatures.name: Instinct

classFeats.name: Acute Vision
classFeats.rules_text: When you are raging, your visual senses improve, granting you darkvision.

classFeats.name: Adrenaline Rush
classFeats.rules_text: When you are raging, your visual senses improve, granting you darkvision.

classFeats.name: Draconic Arrogance
classFeats.rules_text: When you are raging, your visual senses improve, granting you darkvision.

classFeats.name: Moment of Clarity
classFeats.rules_text: You push back your rage for a moment in order to think clearly. Until the end of this turn, you can use actions with the concentrate trait even if those actions don't have the rage trait.

classFeats.name: Raging Intimidation
classFeats.rules_text: Your fury fills your foes with fear. While you are raging, your Demoralize and Scare to Death actions (from the Intimidation skill and an Intimidation skill feat, respectively) gain the rage trait, allowing you to use them while raging. As soon as you meet the prerequisites for the skill feats Intimidating Glare and Scare to Death, you gain these feats.

classFeats.name: Raging Intimidation
classFeats.rules_text: With a quick sprint, you dash up to your foe and swing. Stride twice. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy. You can use Sudden Charge while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

insticts.description: While raging, you gain the ape's unarmed attack (or attacks), but you’re unable to use weapons. These attacks are in the brawling group. Your Rage action gains the morph and primal traits.

features.description: You strike with your Fist that you gained from raging.
features.name: Fist
features.rules_text: Take the strike action with your fist. It deals 1D10 Bludgeoning damage and has the following traits: Grapple, Unarmed

insticts.name: Ape

insticts.description: While raging, you gain the bear's unarmed attack (or attacks), but you’re unable to use weapons. These attacks are in the brawling group. Your Rage action gains the morph and primal traits.

features.description: You strike with your Jaws that you gained from raging.
features.name: Jaws
features.rules_text: Take the strike action with your jaws. It deals 1D10 Piercing damage and has the following traits: Unarmed

features.description: You strike with your Claws that you gained from raging.
features.name: Claws
features.rules_text: Take the strike action with your claws. It deals 1D6 Slashing damage and has the following traits: Unarmed, Agile
